# ROVR

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 1 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A dark live-radio shell: black page, a painted yellow (#FFF057) that is not the same as the --primary token, italic kernStandard nav, square auth links on a yellow gate, and pill player controls..

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public home, moods, schedule, about, privacy, and the /login gate; Google and Apple buttons were not pressed; no email field was on the page). Themes: dark, light.

ROVR is a live radio product (Radio Reinvented, v1.0.1). This package covers the public signed-out web app at `https://www.rovr.live/` on 2026-11-19: home, moods, schedule, about, privacy, and the signed-out `/login` gate. The live theme was `html.dark`. No account was created.

## Typography

5 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: gtAlpina, kernStandard.

### Fonts (from README.md)

kernStandard is the UI face (body, nav, buttons, headings). The page loads 400, 700 and 700 italic, with a fallback named kernStandard Fallback, then `system-ui`. gtAlpina is the curator and label face (300 italic declared). Roboto is the player clock (weights 100 to 500 declared; the clock computed at 300). All three are the product's own faces. They are named here and not committed.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- Light tokens are declared, not shown. Do not treat them as a captured surface.
- `--primary` and the painted yellow are different colours. Buttons use the painted one.
- No screenshot backs these numbers. The readings are the evidence.
- Hover, focus, pressed and disabled were not forced. A global focus rule clears the outline.
- The viewport was 1169, not 1440, and no 390 pass was taken.
- Alpha colours (nav at 0.5, clock at 0.3) are in the readings and not in `tokens.json`, because the catalog colour parser accepts hex and `rgb()` only.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- Do use the painted yellow `#FFF057` for buttons, rules and display type. That is what the page paints.
- Do set the page to black `#000000` with near-white `#FAFAFA` body text in the live theme.
- Do keep corners square on the auth links and the track card, and use a full pill on Message, Listen and the icon buttons.
- Do set kernStandard for UI and gtAlpina for names.
- Don't use `--primary` (`#FFFF57`) where the page uses the painted yellow. They are not the same.
- Don't ship the light palette as if a light page was captured.
- Don't invent a screenshot for a frame the browser did not produce.
